open_forest.closed: The forest and the Deku Tree stay closed until the story opens them, and the Kakariko gate stays closed.
open_forest._: Whether the way out of the forest and into the Deku Tree is blocked. Closed also closes the Kakariko gate. An open Kakariko gate needs the forest open, since its story state skips the Deku Tree quest past Mido; with an open Kakariko gate, Closed is locked out.

open_kakariko.open: The gate is open from the start and the castle visit is skipped. Zelda's Letter and the Song from Impa, or whatever is placed there, are given when a new game starts.
open_kakariko.closed: The gate opens when you show Zelda's Letter to the guard.
open_kakariko._: Whether the Kakariko Village gate to Death Mountain starts open. Open also skips the castle visit: a new game starts after Zelda and Impa, with their two items already given. Needs Kokiri Forest set to Open; with Closed the gate is locked to Closed, and a seed that asks for both is refused.

open_door_of_time._: Start with the Door of Time already open, so the Ocarina and the Song of Time are not needed to reach the Master Sword. The Door of Time quest is left alone, so Zelda's escape and the Song of Time stay checks. The adult pedestal works before the Forest Sage in every seed, with or without this setting.

zora_fountain.closed: King Zora must be moved with Ruto's Letter.
zora_fountain.adult: King Zora is gone once you are an adult.
zora_fountain.open: King Zora never blocks the way. Ruto's Letter stays in the item pool.
zora_fountain._: Whether King Zora blocks the way to Zora's Fountain.

gerudo_fortress.fast: Tested in game. Three carpenters start free. The Membership Card is vanilla and is granted when the last carpenter is rescued.
gerudo_fortress.open: Tested in game. Start with the Gerudo Membership Card and the bridge built. The Membership Card check is still in the game and randomized. It triggers when you interact with your first jail cell.
gerudo_fortress._: How many carpenters must be rescued to open the Fortress.

shuffle_chests.off: These checks keep their original items.
shuffle_chests.overworld: Only checks outside dungeons are shuffled.
shuffle_chests.dungeons: Only checks inside dungeons are shuffled.
shuffle_chests.all: Every check of this kind is shuffled.
shuffle_chests._: Which treasure chests hold random items, including the chests only the remake has.

shuffle_pots.off: These checks keep their original items.
shuffle_pots.overworld: Only checks outside dungeons are shuffled.
shuffle_pots.dungeons: Only checks inside dungeons are shuffled.
shuffle_pots.all: Every check of this kind is shuffled.
shuffle_pots._: Which pots, including flying pots and the pots only the remake has, hold random items. Key items whose pickup pack is built can sit in a pot. A shuffled pot gives its item once and stays broken in the save. An item you do not pick up is lost and can make the seed unbeatable, so save before breaking pots that may hold key items. Flying pots work the same way. Experimental, untested in the game.

shuffle_crates.off: These checks keep their original items.
shuffle_crates.overworld: Only checks outside dungeons are shuffled.
shuffle_crates.dungeons: Only checks inside dungeons are shuffled.
shuffle_crates.all: Every check of this kind is shuffled.
shuffle_crates._: Which crates, including the crates only the remake has, hold random items. Key items whose pickup pack is built can sit in a crate. A shuffled crate gives its item once and stays broken in the save. An item you do not pick up is lost and can make the seed unbeatable, so save before breaking crates that may hold key items. Experimental, untested in the game.

shuffle_scrubs.off: Only the three scrubs that give one-time items are shuffled.
shuffle_scrubs.low: Every scrub sells its item for 10 rupees.
shuffle_scrubs.random: Each scrub gets a random price.
shuffle_scrubs._: Whether Business Scrub sales hold random items, and what they cost.

shuffle_freestanding_items.off: Only Pieces of Heart are shuffled.
shuffle_freestanding_items.pieces: Heart pieces on the ground and the three heart piece chests are shuffled. Rupees and recovery hearts on the ground stay as they are.
shuffle_freestanding_items.all: Heart pieces, rupees and recovery hearts on the ground are all shuffled, also the 98 rupees and hearts that only the remake has, whose logic region comes from the nearest known checks.
shuffle_freestanding_items.dungeons: Pieces of Heart, and every freestanding item inside dungeons, are shuffled.
shuffle_freestanding_items.overworld: Pieces of Heart, and every freestanding item outside dungeons, are shuffled.
shuffle_freestanding_items._: Which items lying on the ground hold random items. Rupees, hearts, heart pieces, the two shields, the other world pickups the game ships except the Gold Skulltula Token and Fire Arrows, and every key item whose pickup pack is built can be placed there. A spot that exists once per age only takes items that do no harm when found twice, such as rupees, hearts, ammo and gear that a second copy does not change.

disabled_locations._: Checks you drag in here never hold an item the seed needs, only filler and other junk. They stay in the shuffle, so they still change. If too many are excluded for the seed to be beatable, no seed is built.

shuffle_smallkeys.remove: The item is removed and the doors it opens start unlocked.
shuffle_smallkeys.vanilla: The item stays in its original location.
shuffle_smallkeys.dungeon: The item appears somewhere in its own dungeon.
shuffle_smallkeys.regional: The item appears in its dungeon or a nearby area.
shuffle_smallkeys.overworld: The item appears outside of dungeons.
shuffle_smallkeys.any_dungeon: The item appears in any dungeon.
shuffle_smallkeys.keysanity: The item can appear anywhere in the world.

shuffle_bosskeys.remove: The item is removed and the doors it opens start unlocked.
shuffle_bosskeys.vanilla: The item stays in its original location.
shuffle_bosskeys.dungeon: The item appears somewhere in its own dungeon.
shuffle_bosskeys.regional: The item appears in its dungeon or a nearby area.
shuffle_bosskeys.overworld: The item appears outside of dungeons.
shuffle_bosskeys.any_dungeon: The item appears in any dungeon.
shuffle_bosskeys.keysanity: The item can appear anywhere in the world.
shuffle_bosskeys._: Where dungeon Boss Keys can appear.

shuffle_mapcompass.remove: Maps and Compasses are removed and their effects are always on.
shuffle_mapcompass.startwith: You begin with every Map and Compass.
shuffle_mapcompass.vanilla: They stay in their original locations.
shuffle_mapcompass.dungeon: They appear in their own dungeon.
shuffle_mapcompass.regional: They appear in their dungeon or a nearby area.
shuffle_mapcompass.keysanity: They can appear anywhere in the world.
shuffle_mapcompass._: Where Dungeon Maps and Compasses can appear.

shuffle_hideoutkeys.vanilla: Each key stays with its carpenter.
shuffle_hideoutkeys.regional: The keys appear in the Fortress region.
shuffle_hideoutkeys.overworld: The keys appear outside of dungeons.
shuffle_hideoutkeys.any_dungeon: The keys appear in any dungeon.
shuffle_hideoutkeys.keysanity: The keys can appear anywhere in the world.
shuffle_hideoutkeys._: Where the Small Keys of the Thieves' Hideout can appear.

shuffle_ganon_bosskey.lacs_dungeons: Zelda gives the key in the Light Arrows Cutscene, which plays once you hold a set number of Stones and Medallions together. The Light Arrows are shuffled into the item pool. Experimental, untested in the game.
shuffle_ganon_bosskey.remove: The item is removed and the doors it opens start unlocked.
shuffle_ganon_bosskey.vanilla: The item stays in its original location.
shuffle_ganon_bosskey.dungeon: The item appears somewhere in its own dungeon.
shuffle_ganon_bosskey.regional: The item appears in its dungeon or a nearby area.
shuffle_ganon_bosskey.overworld: The item appears outside of dungeons.
shuffle_ganon_bosskey.any_dungeon: The item appears in any dungeon.
shuffle_ganon_bosskey.keysanity: The item can appear anywhere in the world.
shuffle_ganon_bosskey.stones: Collect a set number of Spiritual Stones.
shuffle_ganon_bosskey.medallions: Collect a set number of Medallions.
shuffle_ganon_bosskey.dungeons: Collect a set number of Stones and Medallions together.
shuffle_ganon_bosskey.tokens: Collect a set number of Gold Skulltula Tokens.
shuffle_ganon_bosskey.hearts: Reach a set number of heart containers.
shuffle_ganon_bosskey._: Where Ganon's Castle Boss Key is, or what earns it.

ganon_bosskey_stones._: How many Spiritual Stones award the key.

ganon_bosskey_medallions._: How many Medallions award the key.

ganon_bosskey_rewards._: How many Stones and Medallions together award the key.

ganon_bosskey_tokens._: How many Gold Skulltula Tokens award the key.

ganon_bosskey_hearts._: How many hearts award the key.

bridge.open: The bridge is there from the start.
bridge.vanilla: The Shadow and Spirit Medallions and the Light Arrows are needed.
bridge.stones: Collect a set number of Spiritual Stones.
bridge.medallions: Collect a set number of Medallions.
bridge.dungeons: Collect a set number of Stones and Medallions together.
bridge.tokens: Collect a set number of Gold Skulltula Tokens.
bridge.hearts: Reach a set number of heart containers.
bridge.random: A random requirement other than tokens is chosen.
bridge._: What it takes to make the Rainbow Bridge to Ganon's Castle appear.

bridge_stones._: How many Spiritual Stones open the bridge.

bridge_medallions._: How many Medallions open the bridge.

bridge_rewards._: How many Stones and Medallions together open the bridge.

bridge_tokens._: How many Gold Skulltula Tokens open the bridge.

bridge_hearts._: How many hearts open the bridge.

skip_ganon_trials._: The barrier in Ganon's Castle starts dispelled, so the tower is open without clearing any of the six trials. The trial rooms stay open and their chests and pots can still be checked. Experimental, untested in the game.

trials._: How many of the six trials in Ganon's Castle must be cleared. Any of the six count: below 6, the barrier is dispelled once that many trials are cleared, whichever they are.

triforce_hunt._: Finish by collecting Triforce pieces instead of defeating Ganon.

triforce_count_per_world._: How many Triforce pieces are placed in the world.

triforce_goal_per_world._: How many Triforce pieces you must collect. It cannot exceed the number in the pool.

starting_hearts._: How many heart containers you begin with. Any value other than 3 is written into the game start module.

starting_items._: Items you begin the game with. One copy of each is taken out of the item pool and replaced by Rupee (1). Upgrades are ticked by tier and the highest ticked tier counts: Longshot means two progressive Hookshots, Big Quiver means the Bow and one quiver upgrade, Big Bullet Bag means the Slingshot and one bullet bag upgrade, Giant's Wallet means two wallet upgrades, Double Magic means two magic upgrades, Ocarina of Time means both ocarinas, Golden Gauntlets means all three strength upgrades. Bags start full. Bombchus need a bomb bag. Zelda's Letter cannot be given.

starting_songs._: Songs you already know when the game starts. Each one is taken out of the item pool when its lesson is shuffled. Playing them still needs an Ocarina.

shuffle_rewards.off: These rewards keep their original items.
shuffle_rewards.supported: The rewards whose event the tool can edit.
shuffle_rewards._: Whether the items that NPCs, minigames, Great Fairies and story scenes hand out are shuffled. This is on by default. The Spiritual Stones and Medallions from the bosses and Rauru stay in place unless Dungeon Rewards is also set. Songs have their own setting.

shuffle_boss_hearts._: Whether the Heart Containers that bosses leave behind join the item pool. The random item appears where the heart would, after the boss falls.

shuffle_songs.off: Every song comes from its usual teacher.
shuffle_songs.own: The songs are shuffled among the places that teach songs.
shuffle_songs.anywhere: Songs can appear anywhere, also in pots, crates, freestanding spots and at Gold Skulltulas when those are shuffled, and song locations can hold any item.
shuffle_songs._: Whether the songs you learn from NPCs and Sheik are shuffled. The lessons still play the usual melody scene. A song found anywhere else is handed out like an item with its get window and shows Sheik's harp. Scarecrow's Song is never shuffled. Experimental, untested in the game.

gossip_hints._: Every gossip stone tells you where an important item lies. The stones need no Mask of Truth text change, only the words are replaced.

faster_chests._: Shortens the waiting time in chest openings and item pickup scenes, and big chests open with the short small chest animation instead of the long big chest cutscene, like the OoTR option Fast Chest Cutscenes. The text, the item and the dungeon map, compass and boss key credit are the same.

start_reward.off: You start with no stones or medallions.
start_reward._: Begin the game already holding one random Spiritual Stone or Medallion. The vanilla copy still exists.

skip_intro._: A new game skips the opening movie and the wake up scene in Link's house, and you get control right away.

chests_match_contents._: Chests holding major items, the items that can unlock progress, and boss keys become big chests, and chests holding anything else (rupees, ammo, hearts, maps, compasses and small keys) become small chests, like the OoTR option Chest Appearance Matches Contents. Only the plain wooden chests change; chests that run a story scene, invisible chests and the minigame chests keep their size. A big chest is wider than a small one, so a chest that grows may stand closer to a wall. Experimental, untested in the game.

shuffle_potion_shop._: The Market Potion Shop keeper's free empty bottle and the Red Potion he pours as thanks for the escaped bug become two shuffled checks, and one more Bottle joins the pool. Both checks need a child who has met Zelda, by day, who carries an empty bottle, because while the free bottle holds another item he starts the bug tutorial only for a child with an empty bottle. His shelves still open after the tutorial.

shuffle_rewards_extra._: Also shuffle the rewards that need bigger event edits: the 20 token Skulltula reward, Biggoron and Medigoron.

shuffle_skulltulas.pinned: Only the skulltulas whose remake actor is known for sure are shuffled.
shuffle_skulltulas.matched: Also the pools of skulltulas that share the same logic, and the skulltulas that our hash research pairs with their spot. The skulltulas whose spot is still unsure only drop minor items such as rupees and hearts.
shuffle_skulltulas._: Whether Gold Skulltulas drop random items and their tokens join the item pool. A skulltula can drop items that the game has a pickup for and key items whose pickup pack is built, as a kit pickup that plays the get window. A killed skulltula stays gone only once its dropped item is picked up, and it comes back if the item is left behind.

shuffle_trade_checks._: Each of the ten adult trade quest hand ins also gives one shuffled item the first time. The trade items themselves stay in their vanilla order.

shuffle_scrubs_a._: Also shuffle the Business Scrubs that already sell one item once: the Death Mountain Crater heart scrub and the Lost Woods stick and nut bag scrubs. The price stays and the sale text still names the old item.

shuffle_scrubs_b._: Also shuffle the Business Scrubs in the Lost Woods scrub grotto and in Jabu Jabu's Belly. A scrub that holds another item sells it once for 20 or 30 rupees instead of its menu, and its sale text still names a heart piece.

bombchus_in_logic._: Experimental. Bombchus count as explosives in the seed logic, so walls, switches and enemies that need an explosive can be handled with Bombchus and no Bomb Bag. This follows the OoTR option that considers Bombchus in logic. Only the logic side is done here, the remake gets no separate Bombchu bag and no Bombchu drops. Caution: in our test of the remake, Bombchus only worked once a Bomb Bag and its ammo maximum were set, and a Bombchu pickup gave a count of 0 without them. The game is also reported to gate Bombchu use on a bag or a defeated Dodongo. A seed with this ticked may expect Bombchus where the game will not let you use them.

shuffle_shops.off: Every shop sells its usual goods.
shuffle_shops.shuffle: The usual shop goods move between the shops and keep their prices, nothing new is sold.
shuffle_shops.deals_1: One slot in each shop is a special deal that sells a random item once, the other slots sell shuffled shop goods.
shuffle_shops.deals_2: Two slots in each shop are special deals, the other slots sell shuffled shop goods.
shuffle_shops.deals_3: Three slots in each shop are special deals, the other slots sell shuffled shop goods.
shuffle_shops.deals_4: Four slots in each shop are special deals, the other slots sell shuffled shop goods.
shuffle_shops.random: Each shop gets 0 to 4 special deals, the Kokiri Shop at least one.
shuffle_shops._: Whether the shelves of the eight shelf shops sell shuffled goods or random items, like shopsanity in the N64 randomizer. A slot that sells a random item is a special deal. The Happy Mask Shop gets no special deals. A Goron or Zora Tunic moved to another shop costs a random price in the shopsanity range, and a child can buy it. Prices above 200 rupees need a bigger wallet in the logic. Experimental, none of these edits are tested in the game yet except one Kokiri Shop deal.

shuffle_cows._: The cow in Link's House and the cow in Gerudo Valley each give one extra shuffled item the first time their milk scene starts, with or without a bottle. The milk stays vanilla and stays repeatable. The other cows have their own setting.

shuffle_cows_other._: The six other cows each give one extra shuffled item the first time their milk scene starts, with or without a bottle: the Gerudo Fortress cow, the Death Mountain Trail and Hyrule Field grotto cows, the cow behind Impa's house and the two Lon Lon Ranch stable cows. The five ordinary cows become actor classes of their own. The milk stays vanilla and stays repeatable. Experimental, untested in the game.

shuffle_beehives._: Whether the seven beehives in the covered hole of Kakariko Village hold random items. They are the only beehives in the remake that drop an item. Key items whose pickup pack is built can sit in a hive. A shuffled hive gives its item once and stays fallen in the save. An item you do not pick up is lost and can make the seed unbeatable, so save before bringing down hives that may hold key items. A hive needs an explosive to open the hole and then the Boomerang, the Hookshot or a bow to bring down. Experimental, untested in the game.

skip_cutscenes.story: The opening movie and the first credits movie can be skipped. The six title screen demos stay locked.
skip_cutscenes.all: Also unlocks the six title screen demos. Pressing the skip button on the title screen may then skip a demo.
skip_cutscenes._: Removes the lock that stops the player from skipping some cutscenes. Most cutscenes can already be skipped by holding the skip button, only eight are locked.

anju_one_cucco._: Anju in Kakariko Village counts the cucco game as won when one cucco is in the pen instead of seven. The Bottle reward is the same. The logic needs one cucco too.

big_poe_one._: The Ghost Shop owner in the Market gives the Bottle for the first big poe, where the game wants five. The golden reward after ten big poes is unchanged. The logic needs one big poe.

shuffle_treasure_reward._: Whether the final reward of the Market Treasure Chest Game, a Piece of Heart, holds a random item. Only the first win gives it, later wins give the usual red rupee. The five rooms keep their keys and rupees. Only unique items that do nothing when found twice can be placed there, so no upgrades, ammo, bottles or keys.

shuffle_dungeon_rewards.vanilla: Every boss and Rauru give their usual Stone or Medallion.
shuffle_dungeon_rewards.anywhere: The Stones and Medallions can be anywhere, and the bosses and Rauru can give any item.
shuffle_dungeon_rewards.dungeons: The Stones and Medallions are shuffled among the bosses and Rauru only: each of them gives one random Stone or Medallion.
shuffle_dungeon_rewards._: Where the three Spiritual Stones and six Medallions that the bosses and Rauru hand out can be found.

jabu_open._: Jabu Jabu opens his mouth without a fish, so no fish and no bottle are needed to enter Jabu Jabu's Belly. King Zora still has to be moved first unless Zora's Fountain is open.

time_always_passes._: The day and night clock runs from the start instead of waiting for Kaepora in Hyrule Field and Impa's send off, so night can be reached before meeting Zelda.

early_beds._: Beds offer Sleep until morning and Sleep until night before the Zelda meeting.

navi_return.off: Navi stays quiet when she has no hint.
navi_return.dungeons: Inside a dungeon, Navi offers a trip back to the dungeon entrance.
navi_return.everywhere: Also outside dungeons: back to Kokiri Forest as a child, or the Temple of Time as an adult.
navi_return._: Calling Navi with the D-pad asks whether to head back, like the original game restarting a saved file at the dungeon entrance, in Kokiri Forest or in the Temple of Time. Needs no item. The D-pad calls Navi from the start of a new game, and her room tutorial hints are replaced by the question; enemy hints while targeting stay. Boss rooms, miniboss rooms, the boss rush and the final battle never offer it, since leaving a fight that way left the save button disabled. Experimental, untested in the game.

bunny_hood.off: The Bunny Hood is only a mask, as in the original game.
bunny_hood.speed: Link runs 1.5 times as fast while wearing the Bunny Hood.
bunny_hood.jump: Link also leaves the ground 1.5 times as fast when jumping, so jumps go further.
bunny_hood._: Gives the Bunny Hood the speed boost it has in Majora's Mask, like the OoTR option of the same name. Works for child and adult Link. Done in the player's AI graphs, with no code patch: while the hood is worn, Link's forward speed is multiplied by 1.5 each frame, up to a cap that is higher for adult Link. Experimental.

misc_hints._: Characters who know something tell you, in their own words, like the OoTR option of the same name. Altar: the Temple of Time altar says where each medallion rests. Dampé's diary: says where a Progressive Hookshot is. House of Skulltula: the cursed rich man names each token reward. Frogs: the Zora's River frogs name the prize of their ocarina game and of the rainy song. Great Fairies: each fairy names what she grants next to her price. Sheik: while waiting in the Temple of Time, Sheik says where the Light Arrows are. Malon: says where the Weird Egg went, only while the Kakariko gate starts closed. Mido: lets slip where the Kokiri Sword is. Saria: when you meet her in the Sacred Forest Meadow, she says where the Magic Meter is. Only the words change, in every language, with the hint itself in English. Experimental, untested in the game.

skip_epona_race._: Learning Epona's Song is enough to own Epona, with no ranch visit and no race against Ingo. The first time adult Link plays the song where a horse can be ridden, Epona is registered as his horse and comes, and the Epona quest is marked complete. The logic counts Epona's Song as Epona when this is on, and needs Ingo's race at the ranch when it is off. Experimental, untested in the game.

skip_mask_quest._: The Happy Mask Shop quest starts complete, like the OoTR option Complete Mask Quest: once the shop opens with Zelda's Letter, every mask can be borrowed right away, including the Mask of Truth, without selling the Keaton, Skull, Spooky and Bunny masks first. Selling masks for rupees goes away, which costs no check. Experimental, untested in the game.

plant_beans._: Every magic bean patch starts planted, like the OoTR option Plant Magic Beans, so the adult bean platforms are there from the start. The Magic Bean leaves the item pool, and the bean salesman in Zora's River has one sale left, for 60 rupees, holding a random item when NPC rewards are shuffled. Experimental, untested in the game.

gerudo_bridge_open._: Opens the way to Gerudo Fortress: the broken bridge in Gerudo Valley is repaired from the start, so adult Link can cross without Epona or the Longshot. The carpenters in the Thieves' Hideout are not rescued, so the guards, the rescue and the Gerudo Membership Card stay as they are. Experimental, untested in the game.

shuffle_entrances.off: Every entrance leads where it always does.
shuffle_entrances.dungeons: The eleven dungeon doors lead to other dungeons: Deku Tree, Dodongo's Cavern, Jabu Jabu's Belly, Bottom of the Well, Ice Cavern, Gerudo Proving Ground and the Forest, Fire, Water, Shadow and Spirit Temples. Ganon's Castle, boss rooms, blue warps and warp songs stay. Experimental, untested in the game.
shuffle_entrances.overworld: The area to area transitions of the overworld lead to other areas. Not built yet, a seed with this is refused.
shuffle_entrances.everything: Dungeons, overworld transitions and later interiors and grottos, each kept in its own pool. Not built yet, a seed with this is refused.
shuffle_entrances._: Which doors and transitions lead somewhere else. Entrances are coupled, so the way back always returns you to the door you came in by. Experimental, untested in the game. Only Off and Dungeons work in this build.

shuffle_rocks.off: These checks keep their original items.
shuffle_rocks.overworld: Only checks outside dungeons are shuffled.
shuffle_rocks.dungeons: Only checks inside dungeons are shuffled.
shuffle_rocks.all: Every check of this kind is shuffled.
shuffle_rocks._: Which small liftable rocks hold random items. The adult and the child copy of a rock are separate checks. Key items whose pickup pack is built can sit under a rock. A shuffled rock gives its item once and stays broken in the save. An item you do not pick up is lost, also when a thrown rock drops it out of reach, and that can make the seed unbeatable, so save before lifting rocks that may hold key items. Experimental, untested in the game.

shuffle_grass.off: These checks keep their original items.
shuffle_grass.overworld: Only checks outside dungeons are shuffled.
shuffle_grass.dungeons: Only checks inside dungeons are shuffled.
shuffle_grass.all: Every check of this kind is shuffled.
shuffle_grass._: Which grass tufts hold random items, in the overworld and in the Deku Tree and the Bottom of the Well. Key items whose pickup pack is built can sit in grass. A shuffled tuft gives its item once and stays cut in the save. An item you do not pick up is lost and can make the seed unbeatable, so save before cutting grass that may hold key items. The bug grass of the Lost Woods is left alone. Experimental, untested in the game.

shuffle_silver_rupees._: The silver rupees of five rooms become items: the Forest and Light Trials in Ganon's Castle, the Ice Cavern push block room, the Bottom of the Well basement and the Gerudo Proving Ground slopes room. Each room has five Silver Rupee items that are found in chests anywhere, and the room opens when you have found all five. The spots where the silver rupees hung hold other rupees. Needs Chests shuffled, because the Silver Rupee items are only found in chests. Experimental, untested in the game.

shuffle_frog_songs._: The frogs in Zora's River give one shuffled item the first time you play each of Zelda's Lullaby, Epona's Song, Saria's Song, the Sun's Song and the Song of Time to them, in place of the rupees. The Song of Storms Heart Piece is a check of its own as before.

shuffle_frog_bug_heart._: The first win of the frog bug game in Zora's River, which opens after all six frog songs, gives a shuffled item in place of the Heart Piece. Later wins still give a Blue Rupee.

shopsanity_prices.starting: 10 to 200 rupees, no wallet upgrade needed.
shopsanity_prices.adult: 10 to 500 rupees, the logic asks for the Adult's Wallet above 200.
shopsanity_prices.giant: 10 to 995 rupees, the logic asks for the Giant's Wallet above 500.
shopsanity_prices._: The price range of special deals, named by the wallet that can pay the highest price. The remake's wallets hold 200, 500 and 1000 rupees. Prices lean to the middle of the range, in steps of 5 rupees. Kokiri Shop deals never cost more than 200, so the Kokiri Sword and other early items stay in reach. Shop goods always keep their own price.

deku_bridge_safe._: The wooden bridge in the Deku Tree slingshot room stays up when Link walks, rolls or jumps on it, so you never drop into the pit below it. Nothing else in the dungeon changes and the logic is the same, because the room never needed the bridge to break. Without the Slingshot the jump across has a window of about nine frames, so this keeps the room fair when the chests there hold other items. A bridge that already broke in a save stays broken. Experimental, untested in the game.

shuffle_merchants.off: Medigoron and the Bean Merchant sell their usual items.
shuffle_merchants.beans: The Bean Merchant sells a random item, when Skip Planting Beans is on.
shuffle_merchants.all: Medigoron, and the Bean Merchant when Skip Planting Beans is on, sell a random item.
shuffle_merchants._: Whether the merchants sell a random item. Medigoron is the only one of All But Beans that is built; the Bean Merchant needs Skip Planting Beans.

scrub_prices.fixed: One price for every shuffled scrub.

scrub_price_fixed._: The price of every shuffled scrub when Scrubs Prices is Fixed.

scrub_hint_text._: Shuffled scrubs name the item they really sell. Off, they call it a Mystery Item. The price they say is always the price they take.

merchant_prices.fixed: One price for every shuffled merchant.

merchant_price_fixed._: The price of every shuffled merchant when Merchant Prices is Fixed.

lacs_rewards._: How many Stones and Medallions together make the Light Arrows Cutscene play, which then gives Ganon's Boss Key. Any mix of the three Spiritual Stones and six Medallions counts.

song_harp_colors._: A song found as an item shows Sheik's harp in the colour of that song on the ocarina menu, so you can tell the songs apart before you pick one up. Experimental, untested in the game.

shuffle_ocarinas._: Whether both Ocarinas join the item pool: the Fairy Ocarina from Saria's gift and the Ocarina of Time Zelda throws in the moat after her escape. Off keeps them at those two spots. Both are only shuffled while NPC rewards are.

fairy_prices.vanilla: The fairy's usual offering: 25, 50, 100, 200, 300 or 500 rupees.
fairy_prices.fixed: One price for every Great Fairy.
fairy_prices._: What the six Great Fairies ask as an offering before they grant their reward.

fairy_price_fixed._: The offering every Great Fairy asks when Great Fairy Prices is Fixed.

door_of_time_condition.vanilla: Clear Dodongo's Cavern and Jabu-Jabu's Belly, as in the remake.
door_of_time_condition.stones: Hold all three Spiritual Stones, as in the original game. Zelda's escape waits for the Stones too.
door_of_time_condition.song: Only the Song of Time is needed. Zelda's escape stays on Dodongo's Cavern and Jabu-Jabu's Belly.
door_of_time_condition.open: The Door of Time is open from the start.
door_of_time_condition._: What it takes to open the Door of Time. With a Closed choice, play the Song of Time at the altar in the Temple of Time once the requirement is met.

enemy_health._: How much health enemies and bosses have, from 0.5x to 5x. Health tops out at 99.

enemy_damage._: How hard enemies and their projectiles hit, from 0.5x to 5x. Traps, lava, falls and grabs do their usual damage.

enemy_speed._: How fast enemies move and attack, from 0.75x to 2x. Experimental: most enemies ignore it so far, and only Lizalfos clearly speed up.

no_heart_drops._: Enemies, pots and grass never drop recovery hearts. Hearts placed as items in the seed are still there.

no_gossip_fairies._: Playing a song at a gossip stone no longer brings out a healing fairy.

no_ammo_drops._: Enemies, pots and grass never drop arrows, seeds, bombs, nuts or sticks. Shops and chests still have them, and the logic does not plan for this. Tested on grass only.

lose_heart_on_death._: Each game over costs a heart container, down to three. Being saved by a bottled fairy does not count. Quitting to the title screen gives the hearts back.

no_bottles_in_combat._: You can't use a bottle while the battle music plays or in a boss fight. A bottled fairy still revives you.

enemy_regen._: Enemies you leave alone heal. About 15 seconds after your last hit they get back one point every 5 seconds.

more_enemies._: How many enemies each area has, up to 10x. From 5x, new kinds join in. Above 1x you also get special encounters, such as a Skulltula ambush in Zora's Domain once you have a sword, and rare enemies from grass and pots (untested). Towns and boss rooms get none.

boss_minibosses._: A Stalfos or a Dinolfos joins the fight with Gohma, Barinade, Phantom Ganon and Twinrova. It appears when the fight starts and leaves when the boss is beaten. Played with Gohma and Phantom Ganon; the other bosses are untested.

boss_minions._: Bosses bring a few Keese or Biri, and King Dodongo calls more Baby Dodongos. They appear when the fight starts (Bongo Bongo's are there from the start) and leave when the boss is beaten. Ganondorf and Ganon are unchanged. Played with Gohma and Phantom Ganon; the other bosses are untested.

no_dupe_items._: Two bottles can't hold the same thing, so no second fairy, potion or Poe. Different things in different bottles are fine.

enemies_respawn_sooner._: Beaten enemies come back when you leave the room or area and return, not only after leaving the dungeon or region. Bosses and minibosses stay beaten. Experimental, untested in the game.

no_z_targeting._: You can't lock on to enemies or bosses. Aim assist and targeting people and signs still work.

fairy_helps_enemies._: When you use a bottled fairy, or one revives you, every awake enemy and boss heals to full too.

enemy_backup._: Fight an enemy for too long and it calls in one weaker enemy, once. A Stalfos brings a weak Stalfos, a Wolfos two Keese. Bosses and minibosses never call.

enemy_gates._: At ten narrow spots a barrier blocks the way until you beat its guards. It comes back when the area reloads. As a child they only appear once you have the Kokiri Sword. Off with shuffled entrances.

cucco_revenge._: Hit a Cucco once and the whole flock attacks, instead of after a few hits. Anju's Cuccos and the ones you have to find keep their usual temper.

enemy_spawn_combo._: For fun and practice. Hold both sticks in and press D-pad Down for a random enemy in front of Link, or Up for the same kind again. Up to twelve at once.

door_of_time_escape.vanilla: Clear Dodongo's Cavern and Jabu-Jabu's Belly, as in the remake.
door_of_time_escape.stones: Hold all three Spiritual Stones, as in the original game.
door_of_time_escape.moat: Zelda's escape never plays. The Ocarina of Time waits in the castle moat from the start, with the Song of Time after it.
door_of_time_escape._: With the Door of Time Open or Closed - Song Only: what it takes for Zelda's escape, which leads to the Ocarina of Time in the castle moat and the Song of Time.

door_of_time_song._: On, the Song of Time must be played at the altar once the requirement is met. Off, the door opens by itself as soon as the requirement is met.

shuffle_kokiri_sword._: Whether the Kokiri Sword joins the item pool. Off keeps it in its chest in the Kokiri Forest training area. The chest is only shuffled while overworld chests are.

skip_first_pickup_text._: No "You got X!" box the first time you pick up a rupee, a heart, a magic jar, arrows or Deku seeds. Chests and real items still show theirs.

nocturne_trigger.vanilla: The Forest, Fire and Water Temples are cleared, as in the remake.
nocturne_trigger.classic: Hold the Forest, Fire and Water Medallions, as in the original game.
nocturne_trigger._: What makes Kakariko burn, where Sheik teaches the Nocturne of Shadow to adult Link. Untested in the game.

prelude_trigger.vanilla: The Forest Temple is cleared, as in the remake.
prelude_trigger.classic: Hold the Forest Medallion, as in the original game.
prelude_trigger._: What makes Sheik teach the Prelude of Light to adult Link in the Temple of Time. Untested in the game.

unbreakable_bowling_grass._: The grass in the Bombchu Bowling lanes can't be broken, so steer your Bombchus around it.

fireball_storms._: Burning rocks rain down on a few quiet stretches of Hyrule Field and the Hyrule Castle garden, like on Death Mountain. Dodge them.

faster_blocks._: Pushable and pullable blocks slide twice as fast.

debug_location_names._: For checking the location data. After an item get, a text box shows the internal name of the location the item came from, such as [KF Midos Top Left Chest]. Covers chests, NPC, song and event rewards, Gold Skulltulas and items on the ground. Items on the ground need a button press, and a placed item missing from the location list says so. Experimental.

presets.name: Default
presets.tip: Chests and the story and NPC rewards are shuffled, and keys stay in their own dungeon. Everything else keeps the standard rules.

presets.name: Easy
presets.tip: Keys are removed, the world is mostly open and the goals are short. A good first seed.

presets.name: Keysanity
presets.tip: Every dungeon key can be anywhere in the world. Maps and compasses are given to you.

presets.name: Full shuffle
presets.tip: Every kind of check is shuffled and keys can be in any dungeon. Long and demanding.

presets.name: Open world
presets.tip: Nothing blocks your way. You start as an adult and the bridge is already up.

view.label: Ganon's Boss Key
view.tip:
Vanilla - Ganon's Boss Key will appear in the vanilla location.

Own dungeon - Ganon's Boss Key can appear anywhere inside Ganon's Castle.

Start with - Places Ganon's Boss Key in your starting inventory.

Any dungeon - Ganon's Boss Key can only appear inside of any dungeon.

Overworld - Ganon's Boss Key can only appear outside of dungeons.

Anywhere - Ganon's Boss Key can appear anywhere in the world.

Trigger - These settings put the boss key on a trigger, granting the key once the requirements are met:
- Stones: Obtain the specified amount of Spiritual Stones.
- Medallions: Obtain the specified amount of medallions.
- Dungeon rewards: Obtain the specified total sum of Spiritual Stones or medallions.
- Dungeons: Complete the specified amount of dungeons. Dungeons are considered complete after stepping into the blue warp after the boss.
- Tokens: Obtain the specified amount of Skulltula tokens.
- Triforce Pieces: Obtain the specified amount of Triforce Pieces.

LACS - Dungeon Rewards - Zelda gives Ganon's Boss Key in the Light Arrows Cutscene, which plays once you hold the set number of Stones and Medallions together. The Light Arrows are shuffled into the item pool. Experimental, untested in the game.

Same Region - Ganon's Boss Key can only appear in Ganon's Castle or a nearby area.

view.label: Kokiri Forest
view.tip:
Whether the way out of the forest and into the Deku Tree is blocked.

Open - Nothing blocks the forest or the Deku Tree.

Closed - The forest and the Deku Tree stay closed until the story opens them, and the Kakariko gate stays closed.

Open Kakariko needs Open: with the Kakariko gate open, Closed is locked out.

view.label: Door of Time
view.tip:
What it takes to open the Door of Time. With a Closed choice, walk up to the altar in the Temple of Time and play the Song of Time once the requirement is met.

Closed - Vanilla - Clear Dodongo's Cavern and Jabu-Jabu's Belly (the remake's own rule).

Closed - Classic - Hold all three Spiritual Stones.

Closed - Song Only - No other requirement: just the Song of Time and an Ocarina. Zelda's Escape then sets what the Ocarina of Time in the castle moat waits for.

Open - The Door of Time is already open. Zelda's Escape then sets what the Ocarina of Time in the castle moat waits for.

view.label: Zora's Fountain
view.tip:
Closed - King Zora obstructs the way to Zora's Fountain. Ruto's Letter must be shown as child Link in order to move him in both time periods.

Closed as child - Ruto's Letter is only required to move King Zora as child Link. Zora's Fountain starts open as adult.

Open - King Zora has already mweeped out of the way in both time periods. Ruto's Letter is removed from the item pool.

view.label: Jabu-Jabu
view.tip:
Closed - A fish is required to open Jabu-Jabu's mouth.

Open - Jabu-Jabu's mouth opens without the need for a fish.

view.label: Fortress Carpenters
view.tip:
Sets the state of the carpenters captured by Gerudo in Gerudo Fortress, and with it the number of guards that spawn.

Normal - All 4 carpenters are required to be saved.

Fast - Tested in game. Three carpenters start free. The Membership Card is vanilla and is granted when the last carpenter is rescued.

Open - Tested in game. Start with the Gerudo Membership Card and the bridge built. The Membership Card check is still in the game and randomized. It triggers when you interact with your first jail cell.

Only "Normal" is compatible with Gerudo Fortress Keyrings.

view.label: Gerudo Valley Bridge
view.tip:
Vanilla - The bridge in Gerudo Valley is broken until the carpenters are rescued.

Repaired - The broken bridge in Gerudo Valley is repaired from the start, so adult Link can cross without Epona or the Longshot. The carpenters in the Thieves' Hideout are not rescued, so the guards, the rescue and the Gerudo Membership Card stay as they are. Experimental, untested in the game.

view.label: Rainbow Bridge
view.tip:
Alters the requirements to open the bridge to Ganon's Castle.

Vanilla - Obtain the Shadow Medallion, Spirit Medallion and Light Arrows.

Always open - No requirements.

Stones - Obtain the specified amount of Spiritual Stones.

Medallions - Obtain the specified amount of medallions.

Dungeon rewards - Obtain the specified total sum of Spiritual Stones or medallions.

Dungeons - Complete the specified amount of dungeons. Dungeons are considered complete after stepping into the blue warp after the boss.

Tokens - Obtain the specified amount of Skulltula tokens.

Greg - Find Greg the Green Rupee

view.label: Ganon's Trials
view.tip:
Sets the number of Ganon's Trials required to dispel the barrier.

Skip - No Trials are required and the barrier is already dispelled.

Set Number - Select a number of trials from the slider below. Clearing that many of the six trials, any of them, dispels the barrier.

view.label: Ganon's Trials Count
view.tip: Set the number of trials required to enter Ganon's Tower. Any of the six trials count.

view.label: Shuffle Dungeon Entrances
view.tip:
Shuffle the pool of dungeon entrances, including Bottom of the Well, Ice Cavern and Gerudo Proving Ground.

Shuffling Ganon's Castle can be enabled separately.

Additionally, the entrances of Deku Tree, Fire Temple, Bottom of the Well and Gerudo Proving Ground are opened for both child and adult.

- Deku Tree will be open for adult after Mido has seen child Link with a sword and a shield.
- Bottom of the Well will be open for adult after playing Song of Storms to the Windmill guy as child.
- Gerudo Proving Ground will be open for child after adult has paid to open the gate once.

view.label: Maps/Compasses
view.tip:
Start with - You will start with Maps & Compasses from all dungeons.

Vanilla - Maps & Compasses will appear in their vanilla locations.

Own dungeon - Maps & Compasses can only appear in their respective dungeon.

Any dungeon - Maps & Compasses can only appear inside of any dungeon.

Overworld - Maps & Compasses can only appear outside of dungeons.

Anywhere - Maps & Compasses can appear anywhere in the world.

Same Region - Maps & Compasses can only appear in their dungeon or a nearby area.

view.label: Small Key Shuffle
view.tip:
Start with - You will start with all Small Keys from all dungeons.

Vanilla - Small Keys will appear in their vanilla locations. You start with 3 keys in Spirit Temple MQ because the vanilla key layout is not beatable in logic.

Own dungeon - Small Keys can only appear in their respective dungeon. If Fire Temple is not a Master Quest dungeon, the door to the Boss Key chest will be unlocked.

Any dungeon - Small Keys can only appear inside of any dungeon.

Overworld - Small Keys can only appear outside of dungeons.

Anywhere - Small Keys can appear anywhere in the world.

view.label: Boss Key Shuffle
view.tip:
Start with - You will start with Boss Keys from all dungeons.

Vanilla - Boss Keys will appear in their vanilla locations.

Own dungeon - Boss Keys can only appear in their respective dungeon.

Any dungeon - Boss Keys can only appear inside of any dungeon.

Overworld - Boss Keys can only appear outside of dungeons.

Anywhere - Boss Keys can appear anywhere in the world.

Same Region - Boss Keys can only appear in their dungeon or a nearby area.

view.label: Dungeon Rewards
view.tip:
Where the Spiritual Stones and Medallions can be found.

Vanilla - Rewards are not shuffled. Each boss and Rauru give their usual Stone or Medallion.

End of dungeons - The Stones and Medallions are shuffled only among themselves: each boss and Rauru give one random Stone or Medallion.

Anywhere - The Stones and Medallions can appear anywhere, and the bosses and Rauru can give any item.

view.label: Gerudo Fortress Keys
view.tip:
Vanilla - Thieves' Hideout Keys will appear in their vanilla locations.

Any dungeon - Thieves' Hideout Keys can only appear inside of any dungeon.

Overworld - Thieves' Hideout Keys can only appear outside of dungeons.

Anywhere - Thieves' Hideout Keys can appear anywhere in the world.

view.label: Gold Skulltulas
view.tip:
Whether Gold Skulltulas drop random items, and their tokens join the item pool.

Off - Every Gold Skulltula drops its token.

Dungeons - Gold Skulltulas inside dungeons drop random items.

Overworld - Gold Skulltulas outside dungeons drop random items.

Everywhere - Every Gold Skulltula drops a random item. The ones whose spot is still unsure only drop minor items such as rupees and hearts.

view.label: Freestanding Items
view.tip:
Which items lying on the ground are shuffled. Pieces of Heart on the ground are always shuffled.

Off - Only Pieces of Heart are shuffled.

Dungeons - Every freestanding item inside dungeons is shuffled.

Overworld - Every freestanding item outside dungeons is shuffled.

Everywhere - Every freestanding item is shuffled, including the ones only the remake has.

view.label: Shopsanity
view.tip:
Off - All shop items will be the same as vanilla.

0 Items - Vanilla shop items will be shuffled among different shops.

1-4 Items - Vanilla shop items will be shuffled among different shops, and each shop will contain 1-4 non-vanilla shop items (special deals).

Random - Vanilla shop items will be shuffled among different shops, and each shop will contain a random number (0-4) of non-vanilla shop items. The Kokiri Shop always gets at least one.

A special deal sells its item once. It can hold anything that cannot be held twice, upgrades at the tier you must already have reached, and songs when songs are shuffled anywhere. Ammo, refills and hearts only go to the two Bazaars, the two Potion Shops and the Bombchu Shop, where one purchase closes the slot.

A Goron or Zora Tunic moved out of its own shop costs a random price in the Shopsanity Prices range, and a child can buy tunics in every shop.

Not working yet:
- The Happy Mask Shop gets no special deals.
- Untested in the game except one Kokiri Shop deal.

view.label: Shopsanity Prices
view.tip:
The price range of the non-vanilla shop items, named by the wallet that can pay the highest price. Prices lean to the middle of the range, in steps of 5 rupees, and vanilla shop items keep their own price.

Affordable - Every item costs 10 rupees.

Starting Wallet - 10 to 200 rupees.

Adult Wallet - 10 to 500 rupees. Items above 200 need the Adult's Wallet in logic.

Giant's Wallet - 10 to 995 rupees. Items above 500 need the Giant's Wallet in logic.

The remake's wallets hold 200, 500 and 1000 rupees, and there is no Tycoon's Wallet. Kokiri Shop items never cost more than 200, so the Kokiri Sword and other early items stay in reach.

view.label: Shuffle Scrubs
view.tip:
Off - Only the Hyrule Field grotto scrub (Piece of Heart) is shuffled.

One-Time Sales - Also the three scrubs that sell something once: the Death Mountain Crater scrub (Piece of Heart) and the two Lost Woods scrubs that sell the Deku Stick and Deku Nut upgrades. Prices stay the same, and the sale text still names the original item.

All - Also the two scrubs that sell ammo again and again (Lost Woods grotto Deku Seeds, Jabu Jabu's Belly Deku Nuts) become one-time sales of a random item.

view.label: Scrubs Prices
view.tip:
Vanilla - The same price as the item it replaced.
Cheap Balanced - Prices will range between 0 to 95 rupees, favoring lower numbers.
Balanced - Prices will range between 0 to 300 rupees, favoring lower numbers.
Fixed - A fixed number.
Range - A random point between specific ranges.
Set By Wallet - Set weights that decide the choice of each wallet, and get a random price in that range if that wallet is chosen.

The scrub always says the price it really takes. It calls its item a Mystery Item unless Scrub Hint Text (Hints page) is on.

Not working yet:
- Balanced, Range and Set By Wallet are not built.
- Prices stop at 99, so the starting wallet can always pay.

view.label: Scrubs Fixed Price
view.tip: The price of every shuffled scrub when Scrubs Prices is Fixed.

view.label: Shuffle Merchants
view.tip:
This setting governs if the Bean Salesman, Medigoron, Granny and the Carpet Salesman sell a random item.

Bean Merchant Only - Only the Bean Salesman will have a check.

All But Beans - Medigoron, Granny and the Carpet Salesman will have checks.

All - Apply both effects.

Not working yet:
- Granny and the Carpet Salesman are not built, so All But Beans and All only shuffle Medigoron.
- The Bean Salesman can only be shuffled while Skip Planting Beans is on (Logic / Goal page). Until then, Bean Merchant Only and All are grayed out.

view.label: Merchant Prices
view.tip:
Vanilla - The merchant's usual price.
Cheap Balanced - Prices will range between 0 to 95 rupees, favoring lower numbers.
Balanced - Prices will range between 0 to 300 rupees, favoring lower numbers.
Fixed - A fixed number.
Range - A random point between specific ranges.
Set By Wallet - Set weights that decide the choice of each wallet, and get a random price in that range if that wallet is chosen.

Only shuffled merchants change price (see Shuffle Merchants): Medigoron, and the Bean Merchant. Medigoron shows and takes the new price. The Bean Merchant normally costs 60 once Skip Planting Beans is on.

Not working yet:
- Balanced, Range and Set By Wallet are not built.
- Prices stop at 99, so the starting wallet can always pay.

view.label: Merchant Fixed Price
view.tip: The price of every shuffled merchant when Merchant Prices is Fixed.

view.label: Great Fairy Prices
view.tip:
Vanilla - The fairy's usual offering: 25, 50, 100, 200, 300 or 500 rupees.
Cheap Balanced - Prices will range between 0 to 95 rupees, favoring lower numbers.
Balanced - Prices will range between 0 to 300 rupees, favoring lower numbers.
Fixed - A fixed number.
Range - A random point between specific ranges.
Set By Wallet - Set weights that decide the choice of each wallet, and get a random price in that range if that wallet is chosen.

Every Great Fairy asks the new price, and her offering line names it.

Not working yet:
- Balanced, Range and Set By Wallet are not built.
- Prices stop at 99, so the starting wallet can always pay.
- Untested in the game.

view.label: Great Fairy Fixed Price
view.tip: The offering every Great Fairy asks when Great Fairy Prices is Fixed.

view.label: Shuffle Cows
view.tip:
Each cow gives one extra shuffled item the first time its milk scene starts, with or without a bottle. The milk stays vanilla and stays repeatable.

Covers all eight cows: Link's House, Gerudo Valley, Gerudo Fortress, the Death Mountain Trail and Hyrule Field grottos, behind Impa's house, and the two Lon Lon Ranch stable cows.

view.label: Big Poe Target Count
view.tip: The Poe collector will give a reward for turning in this many Big Poes.
